mechanism_narrative: A persistently low effective federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts below 1300.0 thousand units indicates deteriorating consumer demand, causing the S&P 500 to decline over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: HOUST falls below 1300.0 but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC for HOUST below 1300.0 is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and deceleration in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling occurs but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 240) signals the Federal Reserve will aggressively raise interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: In periods of monetary tightening cycle with CPIAUCSL > 240, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL > 240 in tightening cycles is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%) indicates a tight labor market that sustains consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 5.0% but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods, or the Rank IC for UNRATE < 5.0% is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% indicates a shift to restrictive monetary policy, causing the S&P 500 to decline over the next 5 trading days as equity valuations adjust to higher discount rates.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5% but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS > 0.5% is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous deceleration in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a weakening consumer demand environment, causing the S&P 500 to decline over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue growth prospects deteriorate.
failure_condition: The joint condition of HOUST falling and RSAFS falling occurs but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a quarterly GDP growth rate below 1.5% signals an economic slowdown, causing the S&P 500 to decline over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods with GDPC1 growth rate < 1.5%, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for GDPC1 growth rate < 1.5% in late-cycle expansions is below 0.03.
